scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and a standard-library quadrature check are supplied. This is not independently audited or formally certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to each fixed full-dimensional planar convex polygon containing the origin and to compact displacement sets. Constants need not be uniform across degenerating polygons. No higher-dimensional or inverse-tomography assertion.
title: The corner-energy correction to smoothed covariograms of convex polygons
